question: Someone who donates his money to the society as welfare is called.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Philanthropist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Philanthropist"** refers to a person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by generously donating money to good causes. (मानवहितैषी/परमार्थी)
 
 
• **Example:** The philanthropist donated millions of dollars to build schools and hospitals in underdeveloped areas.
 
 
• A philanthropist is someone who actively contributes to society, often through charitable acts or initiatives aimed at improving the quality of life of others. (मानवता के लिए सहायता करने वाला व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** Bill Gates is a well-known philanthropist who has worked on eradicating diseases like malaria through his foundation.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Philanthropist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Capitalist** (पूंजीपति): A person who uses their wealth to invest in trade and industry for profit according to the principles of capitalism.
 
 
• **Example:** The capitalist invested a significant amount of money into the new tech startup.
 
 

 
• **Donation** (दान): A gift or contribution, typically money, given to a charity, organization, or cause.
 
 
• **Example:** She made a generous donation to the local animal shelter.
 
 

 
• **Honorary** (मानद): Given as an honor without the usual requirements or privileges.
 
 
• **Example:** He was awarded an honorary doctorate for his contributions to science.

The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Patrimony**.
